name: Project Clarification Before Planning
summary: When user requests a new project or complex multi-step workflow, ask targeted questions before creating tasks.

steps.note: Is this > 5 tasks OR vague scope OR no clear deliverable? If yes → clarify. If no → proceed directly.

Open with: 'Before I break this into tasks, I need a few details:' Then ask 2-4 of: (a) What is the exact output/deliverable? (b) What agents/models should work on it? (c) Is there a priority or deadline? (d) What files/data are the inputs? (e) What does success look like?
Do NOT call create_task yet. Stop and wait.
After reply: break into specific tasks of < 30min scope each. One task per source / file / agent / deliverable.
Reply: 'Created N tasks: [titles]'. Stop. TaskRunner will execute sequentially.

notes: SKIP clarification if: user says 'just do it', 'no questions', 'go ahead', 'trust yourself'
SKIP clarification if: request already has clear scope + < 5 tasks
Questions must be specific — never ask 'do you want me to proceed?'
